stops.name: Piz Sardona
stops.quote: The seldom line along the rock face around the Piz Sardona marks the Glarus overthrust - a phenomenon of world interest.
stops.english: The seldom line along the rock face around the Piz Sardona marks the Glarus overthrust - a phenomenon of world interest.

stops.name: Murgsee lake
stops.quote: Few places illustrate the history of the Alps as impressively as the UNESCO World Heritage Site between the Murgsee lake, Pizol and Martin's Hole near Elm.
stops.english: Few places illustrate the history of the Alps as impressively as the UNESCO World Heritage Site between the Murgsee lake, Pizol and Martin's Hole near Elm.

stops.name: Pizol
stops.quote: Few places illustrate the history of the Alps as impressively as the UNESCO World Heritage Site between the Murgsee lake, Pizol and Martin's Hole near Elm.
stops.english: Few places illustrate the history of the Alps as impressively as the UNESCO World Heritage Site between the Murgsee lake, Pizol and Martin's Hole near Elm.

stops.name: Martin's Hole
stops.quote: The Glarus overthrust, particularly attractive to discover around the Martin’s Hole, forms the heart of the 300 square meter Sarganserland- Walensee-Glarnerland Geopark.
stops.english: The Glarus overthrust, particularly attractive to discover around the Martin’s Hole, forms the heart of the 300 square meter Sarganserland- Walensee-Glarnerland Geopark.

stops.name: Tschinglen Alp
stops.quote: The excursion begins on the gondola lift from Elm to the Tschinglen Alp – right through the awe-inspiring gorge.
stops.english: The excursion begins on the gondola lift from Elm to the Tschinglen Alp – right through the awe-inspiring gorge.

stops.name: Firstboden viewpoint
stops.quote: The Alp is the departure point for an approx. 1 ½ hour circular hike to the Firstboden viewpoint.
stops.english: The Alp is the departure point for an approx. 1 ½ hour circular hike to the Firstboden viewpoint.

stops.name: Martinsmad
stops.quote: The panorama extends from Martinsloch across Martinsmad and Mittagshorn down to the deep-cut valley floor.
stops.english: The panorama extends from Martinsloch across Martinsmad and Mittagshorn down to the deep-cut valley floor.
